units.id: mission:Avgi: Aberrant Blockade|As you attempt to land, your sensors warn you of an approaching pod of Aberrant over the horizon, intent on destroying anything that approaches or tries to launch from <origin>. It seems you'll have to fight if you want to land here.|39|0
units.english: As you attempt to land, your sensors warn you of an approaching pod of Aberrant over the horizon, intent on destroying anything that approaches or tries to launch from <origin>. It seems you'll have to fight if you want to land here.
units.italian: Mentre tenti di atterrare, i sensori ti avvertono di un gruppo di Aberrant in avvicinamento oltre l'orizzonte, deciso a distruggere tutto ciò che si avvicina a <origin> o che tenta di partire da lì. Sembra che dovrai combattere se vuoi atterrare qui.

units.english: With the area cleared of Aberrant, you manage to slip through the blockade and land on <origin>.
units.italian: Con la zona ripulita dagli Aberrant, riesci a passare il blocco e ad atterrare su <origin>.
